job.question: In the Baltimore City Employees' Retirement Systems (BCERS) RFP for an alternatives consultant, how many years must the proposing firm have been in business?
job.expected_facts: At least seven (7) years providing general consulting services plus private equity consulting services, or alternatives consulting services only (all minimum qualifications must be met as of November 8, 2024, 3:00 p.m. EDT).
job.acceptance: Seven years is sufficient for the narrow question. Service type and qualification deadline are optional; five-year staff experience is not the firm threshold.

reviews.reason: This is a 2021 Delaware RFP for deferred compensation plan recordkeeping and administration, not the BCERS alternatives-consultant RFP. Its five-year requirement concerns recordkeeping for governmental defined contribution plans, not how long a proposing firm must have been in business.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL FOR DEFERRED COMPENSATION PLAN RECORDKEEPING AND ADMINISTRATION SERVICES ISSUED BY THE OFFICE OF THE STATE TREASURER
The Vendor must currently administer and provide recordkeeping for at least three active defined contribution plans for governmental entities and have done so for at least five years.
